highlights: The plain Wingman entry opens exactly the apps ticked Open when Wingman starts, whether or not Wingman is already running, and nothing when none is ticked.
An app's own launcher opens only that app, and a second click while Wingman is opening an app doesn't open it twice.
Unreadable settings never turn on Open when Wingman starts; Wingman keeps the last settings it read.
Wingman keeps a small local event log to help trace launch problems.
